title: TAMIU's online school counseling master's ranked No. 1 in Texas for 2027
excerpt: Texas A&M International University's online Master of Science in School Counseling has been ranked No. 1 in CounselingPsychology.org's Best Master's in Counseling in Texas 2027 list, according to TAMIU.
content:
Texas A&M International University's online Master of Science in School Counseling has been ranked No. 1 in Texas for 2027, according to TAMIU.

The ranking, published by CounselingPsychology.org as its Best Master’s in Counseling in Texas 2027 list, highlighted TAMIU's online program as a top option for certified Texas teachers looking to advance their careers, the university said.

The ranking shortlisted 10 counseling programs across Texas, weighing affordability and net price, online and hybrid availability, graduation and retention rates, post-graduation earnings and debt, and accreditation and licensure alignment, according to TAMIU. The site reported an institution-wide average net price of $3,637 for TAMIU, based on federal College Scorecard data.

The program requires applicants to hold a valid Texas teaching certificate and have two years of classroom teaching experience. The 48-credit-hour degree can be completed in about 16 months, with seven-week courses and six start dates per year, and includes two practicums totaling 160 clock hours. It prepares students for the Texas Examinations of Educator Standards School Counselor examination, TAMIU said.

Coursework covers counseling theories, human growth and development, career counseling, multicultural issues, crisis intervention, group counseling and addictions, according to the university.

Sources:

  • Texas A&M International University, “TAMIU School Counseling Program Named #1 by Leading Counseling Psychology Website,” Oct. 29, 2026
